candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - point density considered in the LiDAR programme
verified_facts: For a 1m DSM the point cloud has an average density of at least 1 point per square metre across the survey.
For 50cm the stated average is 4 ppsqm and for 25cm 16 ppsqm.
The density statement is for the DSM, not the DTM; under vegetation the points making up the DTM need not reach 1 ppsqm at 1m resolution.
A point cloud is not a regular grid, so EA distinguishes point density from raster resolution.
semantic_limits: Raster resolution cannot be converted directly into a guaranteed bare-earth point density or sample count inside a parcel.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer
verified_facts: OS describes the product as a detailed representation of the physical landscape including buildings, roads, rivers, land use and natural features.
The product is updated every six weeks.
It provides topographic identifiers (TOIDs) for referencing mapped features.
semantic_limits: TOIDs and mapped physical features provide topographic context only; they do not replace HMLR title identity or exact legal-boundary evidence.
